title: Pure Butterspy
summary: Dextra's Butterspy archetype paired with Level 4 Warrior extenders (Goblindbergh, Photon Thrasher, and Kagetokage), Reinforcement of the Army, and Rank 4 Xyz bosses. By swarming Level 4 Warriors and changing opposing monsters' battle positions, the deck drains enemy stats to 0 and closes games with Photon Papilloperative, Photon Alexandra Queen, and Heroic Champion - Excalibur.

summary.title: Starters & Level 4 Swarm
points: Goblindbergh Special Summons a Level 4 or lower monster from the hand on Normal Summon and switches to Defense Position, which can simultaneously trigger Blue Mountain Butterspy in the hand.
Blue Mountain Butterspy Special Summons itself from the hand whenever you Normal Summon a Warrior monster, turning any Warrior Normal Summon into an instant Rank 4 Xyz.
Moonlit Papillon Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Butterspy monster from the Deck whenever it is sent from the field to the GY (such as when used for a Link Summon).

Photon Thrasher Special Summons itself while you control no monsters, Kagetokage Special Summons itself when you Normal Summon a Level 4 monster, and Reinforcement of the Army searches any Warrior starter.

summary.title: Opening: Goblindbergh + Blue Mountain Butterspy
steps: Normal Summon Goblindbergh; activate its effect to Special Summon Morpho Butterspy or Swallowtail Butterspy from the hand while chaining Blue Mountain Butterspy in the hand to Special Summon itself.
Overlay two Level 4s into Photon Papilloperative (or overlay two Butterspy monsters into Photon Alexandra Queen).

Detach a material from Photon Papilloperative to switch an opposing Defense Position monster to Attack Position and reduce its ATK by 600, triggering Morpho Butterspy on the field to drain another 1000 ATK and DEF.

summary.title: Position Changes & Stat Draining
summary.text: Swallowtail Butterspy switches an opposing monster to Defense Position whenever another monster you control inflicts battle damage, and Butterspy Protection switches an opponent's Attack Position monster to Defense Position while halving battle damage for the turn. Photon Papilloperative then forces a Defense Position monster into face-up Attack Position and cuts its ATK by 600, and every battle position change triggers Morpho Butterspy once per turn to permanently strip an opposing monster of 1000 ATK and DEF.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Photon Alexandra Queen (made with 2 Butterspy monsters) detaches 1 material to return all monsters on the field to the hand and inflict 300 burn damage to each player for every card returned to their hand.
Photon Papilloperative forces opposing walls into Attack Position with -600 ATK so your Warriors can run over them.

Heroic Champion - Excalibur detaches 2 materials to double its original ATK to 4000 until the end of the opponent's turn, while Blade Armor Ninja detaches 1 material to attack twice per Battle Phase (triggering Swallowtail Butterspy twice).
Time Thief Redoer provides turn-one Rank 4 control when going first.

allow.Kagetokage: Special Summons itself when you Normal Summon a Level 4 Butterspy to facilitate 3-material Rank 4 Xyz Summons.
allow.Photon Thrasher: Special Summons itself when you control no monsters as a Level 4 Warrior to enable quick Rank 4 plays.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches any Level 4 Butterspy Warrior monster from the Deck.
allow.Heroic Champion - Excalibur: Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that detaches 2 materials to double its ATK to 4000 against 0 ATK monsters.
allow.Blade Armor Ninja: Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that detaches 1 material to attack twice per Battle Phase.
allow.Time Thief Redoer: Rank 4 staple boss providing non-destruction removal and disruption on the opponent's turn.
